Being able to create and fit such models in real- time may be computationally difficult. Creating a user interface that elucidates and enables model selection would also be needed. All model selection work could couple with attenuation-aware SDF (Sec. 5.3) and with full-spectral analyses (Sec. 5.4), in fact, Ref. [57] shows one example of the latter. A general framework for incorporating and testing context-constrained physical models for source terms should be developed, the specific models that are relevant for a specific use case likely differ wildly and therefore some application-specific model development would likely need to follow. The methods of solving SDF reconstructions often feature configurable hyperparameters. Furtherstudyintohyperparameterselectionandoptimizationandtheabilitytodoinnear-realtime could naturally compliment the model selection work. 6 Conclusion This report has summarized the state-of-the art of SDF technologies, summarized outreach efforts related to the RDF scoping study, highlighted the applicability of SDF and related methods to a LBNL Report #2001653 wide variety of NNSA and related agencies’ applications, and listed a variety of R&D opportunities that would potentially allow for the SDF technology to beneficially impact those applications.
